speaker: character
text: I read your proposal. Thanks, but no. The one-to-one sessions work, and the parents trust them.

speaker: candidate
text: But it's clearly better, trust me. The old way is outdated.

speaker: character
text: What makes you so sure it works better?

speaker: candidate
text: Lots of schools do this now. I read that group learning is more effective.

speaker: character
text: Say we tried it. What could go wrong, and who would pay for it?

speaker: candidate
text: Parents may worry, so we'd tell them first. If the results drop, we switch back.

speaker: character
text: The others already have full Saturdays. Who's going to run this?

speaker: candidate
text: If you say no, I'll ask the tutors directly and start without you.

speaker: character
text: Alright. One trial. But I want to know exactly how it would work.

speaker: candidate
text: Let's just start next week and figure out the details as we go.

speaker: character
text: Two pupils came out confused, and a mother called me. So. What now?

speaker: candidate
text: Let's keep the trial but fix what confused them.
